sentences.text: It sends every sort s to the top drawer of s, each symbol to its copy in the top dimension, each K composition to the composition of top cells along dimension K, and each K source to the identity of the heterogeneous source.
Unifying after graduating gives back exactly what we started with.
Graduating after unifying gives a naturally isomorphic algebra:
each lower cell is replaced by its identity in the top dimension.
So graduation is left adjoint to unification, in an adjoint equivalence whose unit is the identity:
the two presentations give equivalent categories, and nothing is lost by choosing either of them.
